purpose: immutable run snapshot for v5 identity-aware bounded landmark experiments: record sha256/size of the frozen split, label sources, annotation spec, protocols and gate before training; verify at pre_train / pre_selection / post_train; any mismatch marks the run INVALID

checks.rule: create the snapshot immediately before training; verify at every phase; any sha/size/existence mismatch marks the run INVALID and the training CLI must exit non-zero without writing a selectable model
checks.immutable: the snapshot file is never rewritten after creation; verification results are appended to a separate check log

label_sources.train: dev 160 frames (labels_train) + reused exploratory 279 frames (labels_v1) + identity train representative frames 27 (labels_identity_dev, groups target_alone/near_trunc/ms1_alone)
label_sources.train_merged: outputs/landmark_train/dataset/labels_train_v5_merged.json is produced by the training prepare step BEFORE --create; it must combine the three train sources with the v5 freeze group rules
label_sources.val_identity: 35 representative frames (labels_identity_dev, both_*/full_occlusion); identity metrics are reported on val_identity, not mixed into the main joint threshold selection

t25_t26_pending.reason: the T25 formal capture run failed (CUDA OOM) and pilot poses are unconfirmed; T26 labels exist only for those unconfirmed images, so v5 does not include mutual-occlusion / far-MS1 groups or labels; record as INCOMPLETE gap

notes: only repo-relative paths; no machine-private absolute paths
labels are never shared as mutable files: training and evaluation read the frozen paths recorded here
weights and logs stay in ignored outputs/; the snapshot records hashes only
this manifest is frozen by T28; the v1 manifest belongs to the v4.1 candidate-A runs and is not modified
scope: bounded internal landmark experiment; shadow only; no PPO/control/board/navigation/Gate claims
license: internal bounded research only (user 2026-11-04); external distribution undecided; not a legal conclusion
